author: task G3 quick screens; rules fixed before any out-of-sample number for (b) and (c) was computed, and before the graduation tapes for (a) finished downloading

common.statistics: weighted mean EV per trade, 90% bootstrap CI by launch (2,000 resamples), one-sided bootstrap p for EV>0 (or for a difference>0), Benjamini-Hochberg over every configuration listed in the screen

a_graduation_momentum.universe: the 81 graduations of data/cache/graduated_window.json (Oct 13 12:11 - Oct 14 07:21 UTC) with a known migrate/complete block time from analysis/scripts/gap5/grad.json; mayhem completions (comp.mayhem == 1) excluded
a_graduation_momentum.data: swap-api trades, cursor at migrate time + 120 s, up to 3 pages per coin (<= 300 requests in total, <= 36/min)

entries.G_MIG: react to the migrate transaction (CreatePoolEvent) seen in slot m: land first in slot m+1; entry state = after every trade of slots <= m
entries.G_FIRST: react to the first PumpSwap trade (slot f): land first in slot f+1; entry state = after every trade of slots <= f

a_graduation_momentum.pool_model: constant product with K = 84.99 SOL x 206.9M tokens (gap-5: fresh pool opens at 410.8 SOL mcap); state recovered from the post-trade priceSol; validated against each trade's own (sol, tokens); 1.25% fee per side
a_graduation_momentum.primary_exit: first of: realised +15%, 1 s with no trade, price -15% after 1 s, landing slot + 5 (fills one slot later); there is no bundle-wallet leg on a graduated pool
a_graduation_momentum.secondary_grid: TP in {10, 15, 30}% x cap in {slot+5, 10 s, 60 s} x entry in {G_MIG, G_FIRST} = 18 configurations, BH over 18
a_graduation_momentum.split: first half by completion time = look, second half = test; report both and pooled; n is tiny so this is a screen
a_graduation_momentum.pass_rule: primary config EV > 0 on the test half AND pooled lower 90% bound > 0

b_second_wave.universe: LEAD trades (multi-wallet bundled launches) whose LEAD exit reason is the +15% take-profit
b_second_wave.trigger: after our TP fill, the first slot end within W s of the TP fill slot where end-of-slot mcap <= (1 - d) x running max of mcap since our entry, provided no bundle wallet and no creator/signer has sold before that slot end
b_second_wave.entry: land first in the slot after the trigger slot (entry state = end of trigger slot), +1.1% premium, 0.5 SOL, 0.004 SOL
b_second_wave.exit: LEAD exit spec from the re-entry landing slot
b_second_wave.grid: d in {0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20} x W in {10, 30} s = 8 configurations, BH over 8 x 4 out-of-sample sets
b_second_wave.split: look = gap-3 train (first 60% by time); out of sample = gap-3 test, deep, fresh, window
b_second_wave.metric: EV per second-wave trade; also the added SOL per LEAD trade
b_second_wave.stress: re-entry behind every trade of slot trigger+1 (one slot slower); premium +3.6%
b_second_wave.pass_rule: primary EV > 0 on pooled OOS with lower 90% bound > 0 and BH q <= 0.10, and not negative on the window

c_hour_and_create_rate.claim_under_test: the LEAD makes about +15% per trade at 18-21 UTC (seen on gap-3 test + fresh, i.e. formed on those sets)
c_hour_and_create_rate.H1_hour: EV(launch hour in 18,19,20 UTC) - EV(other hours) > 0, tested on sets that did not form the claim: gap-3 train and the deep sample (the window has no 18-21 UTC launches)
c_hour_and_create_rate.H2_create_rate: creates per hour in the 60 min before the launch (full gap-1 create index, every successful mint-authority signature); threshold = the gap-3-train median over multi-wallet launches; EV(rate >= threshold) - EV(rate < threshold) > 0 on gap-3 test, deep, fresh and window; for the window also a within-window median split (its rates are all low)
c_hour_and_create_rate.H3_rate_10min: the same with the 10-minute create count (shorter memory)
c_hour_and_create_rate.pass_rule: difference > 0 with BH q <= 0.10 over all H1-H3 tests, and same sign on the window where testable
